decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (381/01, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/03, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/04, undated, received 05/08/13;  381/05, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/08, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/EX1, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/EX2, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/EX3, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/EX4, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/EX5, undated, received 05/08/13; 381/EX6, undated, received 05/08/13; and Design & Access Statement, dated 31/07/13, received 05/08/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of front and rear roof extensions and creation of new office space on second floor
